premises.text: Homes with central HVAC have uncomfortable overheated/overcooled rooms and high heating/cooling energy bills because vents and airflow are not intelligently redirected
premises.evidence_span: The same household has an average of two to four rooms that are overheated or overcooled at various times

premises.text: KeenVent is a wirelessly networked, user-installable smart vent that automatically redirects HVAC airflow in unoccupied rooms
premises.evidence_span: a wirelessly networked home air vent that maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system by automatically redirecting the air

premises.text: Lifestyle Survey inputs program each vent's smart-cycle schedule so users need not manually program vents
premises.evidence_span: these inputs will allow us to program each individual vent's opening and closing schedule, or smart cycle

premises.text: Online account enables ongoing services such as weather-based schedule alerts and push notifications
premises.evidence_span: we would send an alert to their mobile device and recommend a one-time change to their event schedule

premises.text: Go-to-market via e-commerce then retail, plus partners (home builders, HVAC suppliers, utilities) with subsidies for peak-load efficiency
premises.evidence_span: we will leverage e-commerce partnerships to sell the KeenVent directly to consumers via the web

premises.text: Two commercial offers: lower hardware price with monthly SmartCycle subscription, or higher one-time lifetime price with no monthly fee
premises.evidence_span: A four KeenVents system will be sold for $25 with a $4 monthly service fee

value.text: Greater home comfort and lower HVAC energy use/cost through intelligent airflow redirection
value.evidence_span: eliminates uncomfortable hot or cold spots throughout the home. And more importantly, it reduces the HVAC system runtime

causal_links.evidence_span: maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system
utility companies are looking for energy efficiency products that help them with their peak load management initiatives
yield average annual savings for our customers of one hundred and fifty to three hundred dollars

notes: Comfort and efficiency benefits of smart cycle treated as value outcomes of P2/P3, not separate premises (process+performance package). Matching non-networked vents treated as aesthetic accessory detail, not a separate value mechanism. Indiegogo pre-orders excluded as traction.
